title: When LLM Routers Overpay: The Cost of Strong-Model Preference
abstract: arXiv:2602.03478v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: LLM routing aims to reduce inference costs by assigning easy queries to less expensive models and reserving stronger models for cases in which they are needed. However, we find that existing routers often violate this principle under loose cost budgets: as the budget increases, they increasingly select the strongest and most expensive model even when less expensive feasible candidates provide comparable or identical utility. We refer to this behavior as strong-model over-selection under loose budgets. Our analysis shows that ambiguity alone does not explain this phenomenon. Substantial overpayment can arise when differently priced models offer equivalent or near-equivalent utility and the router retains a persistent model-level preference for costly models; budget relaxation exposes this preference by making premium candidates feasible. translated_title: 当LLM路由器过度支付时：强模型偏好的代价
translated_abstract: LLM路由的目标是通过将简单查询分配给较便宜的模型，并将更强大的模型保留给真正需要它们的场景，从而降低推理成本。然而，我们发现现有路由器在宽松的成本预算下经常违背这一原则：随着预算增加，它们越来越多地选择最强大、最昂贵的模型，即使较便宜的可行候选模型能提供相当甚至相同的效用。我们将这种行为称为“宽松预算下的强模型过度选择”。我们的分析表明，仅凭查询歧义性并不能解释这一现象。当不同价格的模型提供等效或近似等效的效用，而路由器对昂贵模型保持持久的模型级偏好时，就会产生大量的过度支付；预算的放宽通过使高价候选模型变为可行选项而暴露出这种偏好。基于这一诊断，我们提出了EquiRouter，一种决策对齐的路由器，它学习查询级（原文此处截断）
tldr: 该论文发现现有LLM路由器在预算宽松时会因对昂贵强模型的持久偏好而造成过度支付（“强模型过度选择”），并提出决策对齐的路由器EquiRouter来学习查询级的恰当模型分配，从而避免不必要的成本浪费。
en_tdlr: The paper reveals that existing LLM routers overpay under loose budgets due to a persistent preference for stronger, costlier models even when cheaper ones offer equivalent utility, and proposes EquiRouter, a decision-aligned router that learns query-level selection to eliminate such overpayment.
